title: FAIR just-in-time operator access request (fair.access-request.v1)
description: One request for time-bound access to one SaaS instance (F-012 T-18, design §3.9). A pull request adds it as access/requests/<id>.yaml; a second operator approves the pull request; accessctl grants it from start until start + duration (at most 8 hours) and removes it at expiry. The file's name (without .yaml) is the request's id.

operator.description: Who gets the access: a name in access/operators.yaml.

approver.description: The second operator who approves the pull request: a name in access/operators.yaml, never the operator.

instance.description: The instance: a name in access/instances.yaml.

role.description: read-only: view the account and the cluster (no Secrets). operator: also manage workloads (scale, restart, cordon). Neither reads customer data (design §3.9).

duration.description: How long it lasts: minutes or hours (such as 90m or 4h), at most 8h.

revoked.description: Added by a later pull request to end the access early; nothing else in a merged request may change.
